verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman is the head men's basketball coach at High Point University.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Panthers coach Flynn Clayman'; 'Clayman is in his first season as High Point’s [head coach]'. R2: 'The Panthers’ head coach'. R3: 'hiring of Flynn Clayman as the new men's basketball head coach'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly identify Clayman as the current head coach at High Point.

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman was hired on April 11, 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'announced the hiring of Flynn Clayman as the new men's basketball head coach on Friday, April 11th.' (context of post-2024-25 season confirms 2025)
verifications.reasoning: Exact date matches, with timeline context confirming year.

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman was hired as the 15th head coach in High Point University men's basketball program history.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Clayman becomes the 15th men's basketball head coach in program history.'

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman previously served as an assistant coach at High Point University.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Clayman had been Huss’ top assistant for the previous two seasons'. R3: 'spent the last two seasons as the associate head coach and offensive coordinator at High Point University'
verifications.reasoning: Both confirm prior assistant/associate head coach role at High Point.

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman previously served as an assistant coach at Southern Utah.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'assistant from 2017-23' at Southern Utah. R3: 'Prior to High Point University, Clayman was the Associate Head Coach at Southern Utah and spent six seasons at Southern Utah University.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of prior assistant role at Southern Utah.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Clayman is in his first season as High Point’s head coach' (March 2026 article). R3: Hired April 2025 after 2024-25 season.
verifications.reasoning: Timeline directly supports first season as 2025-26.

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman led the Panthers to their first NCAA tournament appearance.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the previous two seasons [as assistant], ... made one NCAA tournament appearance.' R3: 'Clayman helped lead the Panthers to their first ever-NCAA tournament appearance' (as associate head coach under Huss).
verifications.reasoning: First appearance occurred prior to Clayman as head coach, during his assistant tenure; contradicts attribution as leader (implying head coach).

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman led the Panthers to back-to-back Big South Regular Season titles.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'guided the Panthers to back-to-back outright Big South Regular Season titles' (during 'the last two seasons as the associate head coach').
verifications.reasoning: Titles achieved prior to Clayman as head coach, during his assistant tenure; contradicts claim's implication of head coaching leadership.

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman led the Panthers to a 2026 NCAA tournament first-round victory over Wisconsin.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'High Point pulled off ... 83-82 victory against No. 5 seed Wisconsin ... Panthers coach Flynn Clayman' (March 19, 2026). R2: 'High Point’s upset of Wisconsin ... The Panthers’ head coach'.
verifications.reasoning: Directly attributes the 2026 first-round win to Clayman as head coach.

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman was hired following the departure of Alan Huss.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'having assumed the role after Alan Huss left after last season'. R3: Context of hiring after Huss era.
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states hiring followed Huss's departure.

verifications.claim: Alan Huss left to become the associate head coach at Creighton.
